summary: Range and effort proxies (GBIF occurrences, BIEN occurrences and range maps) and counts of infraspecific taxa (GBIF backbone 33,665 subspecies and 40,082 varieties of plants; WCVP checklist) are all openly available, but no single record set joins range size, local abundance and variety counts per species. Abundance exists only in plot data (BIEN, americas) and the three measures would have to be joined by species name.
next_step: Join WCVP infraspecific counts to GBIF/BIEN range and occurrence counts by accepted name for a regional flora with plot abundance, with specimen counts as effort covariate; pre-register before running.
obstacles_confirmed: Occurrence counts confound range, abundance and collecting effort.
Variety counts depend on taxonomic splitting practice.
